defects.description: userIgnoredPatterns starts as an empty list and is filled only by the first successful status poll, so after a service-worker eviction GET_PAGE_STATUS and MANUAL_CAPTURE treat every URL as not ignored and capture a page matching the operator's ignore rule

lastCaptureByTab is not cleared on a case switch (selectorSummaryByTab is), so after capturing a page into Case A and switching to Case B the popup shows the Case A capture record and manifest index under Case B
The popup tells the operator no other case names leave the app while the same component fetches and renders every case name in its case menu
